name: slider
title: Slider
description: A range slider whose thumb is picked up by the cursor and dragged from 20 to 80, with hover and press states on the thumb.
useWhen: Demonstrating a range control being dragged to a target value with hover and press thumb states.
Showing an audio, video or settings slider animating in a product walkthrough.
Composing a settings scene alongside switch and select.
avoidWhen: You need to show completion with no thumb: use progress.
The value is binary: use switch.
You need step-by-step progress with connectors and checks: use stepper.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Show value
variables.description: Show the number above the thumb.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
